en: Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a quiet street and a courtyard flanked by stone buildings with shuttered windows and arched doorways. In the center background is a plain façade with round and arched architectural details and a small fountain or monument in front. Printed captions identify the view as the barracks of Santa Maria Maddalena in Trento. Margins contain Italian and German text and a photographer's imprint along the left edge; there is a handwritten number near the top right.
